q: Fill in the blank with the correct article: There is ___ university in our town.
e: 'University' begins with a 'yu' (consonant) sound, so the article is 'a'.

q: Fill in the blank: Kerala is famous ___ its backwaters.
e: The correct phrase is 'famous for', so the answer is 'for'.

q: Fill in the blank: This time tomorrow, I ___ to Delhi.
e: An action in progress at a definite time in the future takes the future continuous: 'will be travelling'.

q: Choose the correct passive form of: The boy is flying a kite.
o: A kite is flown by the boy.
A kite was being flown by the boy.
A kite has been flown by the boy.
A kite is being flown by the boy.
e: Present continuous active becomes 'is/are being + past participle': 'A kite is being flown by the boy.'

q: Choose the correct indirect form: He said, "I have finished my work."
o: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that he has finished his work.
He said that I had finished my work.
He said that he have finished his work.
e: With a past reporting verb, present perfect changes to past perfect and pronouns change: 'He said that he had finished his work.'

q: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'Obdurate'.
e: 'Obdurate' means refusing to change one's opinion, so its synonym is 'Stubborn'.

q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'Affluent'.
e: 'Affluent' means rich; its opposite is 'Indigent' (very poor).

q: The idiom 'to add fuel to the fire' means:
o: to make a bad situation worse
e: 'To add fuel to the fire' means 'to make a bad situation worse'.

q: One word for 'handwriting that cannot be read':
e: Writing that cannot be read is 'Illegible'; 'ineligible' means not qualified.

q: Find the part with an error: The police / has arrested / the thief. / No error
e: 'Police' always takes a plural verb, so 'has arrested' should be 'have arrested'.

q: Add the correct question tag: She can swim, ___?
e: A positive statement with 'can' takes a negative tag with the same auxiliary: 'can't she'.
